ir.title: Complaint Identification · Intent Recognition
ir.inPhen.c1: Symptom: The customer reports the Guangzhou–Shenzhen leased line is unusable with no packets received from the far end, requesting urgent verification.
ir.inPhen.c2: Symptom: The customer reports poor leased-line experience — intermittent lag and packet loss, services on and off, affecting business.
ir.reason.c1: The user reports the Guangzhou–Shenzhen line is fully down with no packets from the far end. Billing disputes and voice-line faults are excluded first; as the service is completely interrupted, the focus narrows to link-outage issues, initially locking two directions: transport line outage and data line outage.
ir.reason.c2: The user reports poor line experience with intermittent lag/loss and flapping services. Billing disputes and voice-line faults are excluded first; as the service is not fully interrupted, all link-outage issues are further excluded, initially locking two directions: transport line degradation and data line degradation.
ir.action.1: Call the comprehensive-resource leased-line query API with customer code + Guangzhou–Shenzhen cross-domain route as filters, match the in-use line list, locate the XX Bank Guangzhou–Shenzhen SPN leased line and obtain the product number.
ir.action.c1p2: Verified that the line is under transport O&M; combined with the total outage, it is finally identified as a transport leased-line outage.
ir.action.c2p2: Verified that the line is under transport O&M; combined with intermittent quality anomalies, it is finally identified as transport leased-line degradation.

od.s1: (Night service) The customer calls that XX Bank's leased line is down, address: Luchuan District, Guangzhou. Please handle ASAP.
od.s2: The customer calls that the line between its two office sites is unusable and requests urgent on-site handling. Please expedite, thanks.
od.s4: The customer reports that lines 30122059831 / 30122061127 are down, requests a fault-ack reply and progress calls to the account manager. Fault address: Baize District, Guangzhou.
od.s5: The customer reports the company line suddenly became unusable and requests handling. Please follow up, thanks.
od.s3: The customer calls to report a company network fault and requests immediate on-site handling. Please assist and follow up, thanks.
case.desc.c1: The customer says the Guangzhou–Shenzhen leased line is unusable but cannot tell where the problem is, and requests on-site checking ASAP. No commitment given. Please follow up, thanks.
case.desc.c2: The customer reports poor leased-line experience — intermittent lag and packet loss, services on and off, affecting business, and requests troubleshooting.
d1.dd: Notify front-line O&M staff via the mobile O&M app to handle the ticket fault.
d1.sb: Complaint & Intent: Transport leased-line outage complaint.
d1.bjW: Callback confirms resolution; ticket closed, result returned to the process center.
d1.sj: Determine the NETSpirit of each access element from the source and sink ends of the leased line.
d1.rw: Extract complaint-diagnosis request parameters and create the diagnosis task.
d1.zg: Cross-city diagnosis summary: West-GD port no Rx light, Tx normal — fiber break.
d1.yx0: The port receives no light while transmitting normally — fiber break.
d1.fix: After handling, route and port alarms are cleared, optical power back to normal.
d2.bjW: Callback confirms resolution; ticket closed, result returned to the process center.
d2.sb: Complaint & Intent: Transport leased-line degradation complaint.
d2.sj: Determine the NETSpirit of each access element from the source and sink ends of the leased line.
d2.rw: Extract complaint-diagnosis request parameters and create the diagnosis task.
d2.zg: Root cause: weak Rx light, fiber loss ~0.226 km at West-GD 1-3 — tunnel optimization recommended.
d2.xf: Periodic SLA queries show all indicators back to normal.
d2.hf: The leased line has been restored; SLA verification confirms the service is back to normal.
d2.yx0: Diagnosis detail: weak Rx light, Tx normal — overall fiber loss is high.
d2.yx1: Tunnel-optimize: new path for bandwidth, latency, loss.
dj.status: Service status: the leased line is verified normal and in use.
dj.network: Network: the main route is down with signal-loss alarms; the backup route has port alarms.
dj.conclusion: Boundary conclusion: a transport-network line issue.
desc.autoRestore: Authorize the network agent to perform automatic service restoration.

}
